The Falcon BMS platform

Falcon platform: complete system

A modular hardware family for building and testing next-generation battery management systems, from the compute core to isolated high-voltage sensing and cell-level monitoring.

4Modular boards
1600 VMaximum voltage measurement
CAN · Ethernet · EtherCATCommunication
IsolatedCommunication and GPIOs

Simtestlab
1 / 4
Compute Core

Falcon MCU Board

Part no. STL002F125

The compute core of the Falcon platform: a high-performance microcontroller board built for real-time battery management and control. Extensive CAN and Ethernet connectivity plus dedicated ΔΣ-demodulators drive the deterministic control loops at the heart of our BMS.

Key features
  • 1024–2048 KB Flash, 200–352 KB RAM
  • 6-channel USIC [SCI/UART, I²C, I²S, LIN]
  • 6× CAN, 256 MO
  • EtherCAT node
  • External Memory Interface (EBU)
  • Supply voltage range: 3.13–3.63 V
  • 2× PWM Timers (CCU8), 16–64-bit, 8 channels
  • Core frequency: 144 MHz
  • 4× ΔΣ-Demodulators
  • Temperature range: −40 °C to +85 °C / +125 °C
1Falcon MCU Board2Falcon Adapter3Isolation SPI4Pack Monitoring Board
Simtestlab
2 / 4
Interface Board

Falcon Adapter

Part no. STL010F125

The primary interface board for high-voltage battery systems, combining wide-range voltage and bidirectional shunt-based current measurement with a full set of isolated communication and I/O options. Bridges the Falcon MCU to the pack and the surrounding electronics.

Key features
  • 12–24 V DC input power supply
  • Voltage measurement up to 1600 V
  • Bidirectional current measurement using shunt
  • CAN
  • Ethernet
  • EtherCAT
  • SPI
  • UART
  • Isolated communication
  • Isolated GPIOs
1Falcon MCU Board2Falcon Adapter3Isolation SPI4Pack Monitoring Board
Simtestlab
3 / 4
Communication

Isolation SPI

Provides isolated SPI communication for reliable data transfer between electrically isolated system domains, supporting robust communication in high-voltage monitoring and control applications.

Key features
  • Isolated SPI communication
  • Electrical isolation between system domains
  • Reliable data communication for high-voltage applications
1Falcon MCU Board2Falcon Adapter3Isolation SPI4Pack Monitoring Board
Simtestlab
4 / 4
Cell Monitoring

Pack Monitoring Board

Part no. STL009F125

A battery monitoring board designed for multi-cell voltage and temperature monitoring, providing the interface required for accurate cell-level measurement in battery systems.

Key features
  • Multi-cell voltage monitoring
  • Cell temperature monitoring
  • Cell balancing support
  • Battery monitoring interface
  • Daisy-chain communication capability
